verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ  ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran man bach kram hui ikatr  tan tirabhavan gat alakh lakhaiee hai||

en.bdb: Because of the refuge of True Guru and moulding his mind, words and actions as per His teachings, a Guru-conscious person learns the happenings of the three worlds innately. He recognises the true Lord residing within.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਨ ਬਚਨ ਕੈ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਮ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਛਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: man bach karam karam man bachan kai bachan karam man unamanee chhaiee hai ||

en.bdb: With the harmony of actions, mind and words, the thoughts of the mind, the utterance of the words and actions performed are influenced.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਹੂਆ ਕਮਾਦ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੈ ਚੁਆਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: giaanee dhiaanee karanee jiau gur mahooaa kamaadh nijhar apaar dhaar bhaaThee kai chuaaiee hai ||

en.bdb: As wine is brewed from jaggery, sugarcane and Madhuca Indica flowers, so does a Guru-conscious person obtain the unique flow of elixir of Naam when knowledge and concentration of mind are performed by him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੮॥
verses.translit_en: peram ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran hui gurmukh sa(n)dh mile sahaj samaiee hai ||48||

en.bdb: Guru-conscious person satiates himself by drinking deep the loving elixir of Lord's name and by his union with the divine word of the True Guru, he resides in a state of equipoise. (48)
